name: triage
description: Read backlog, categorize, prioritize, route to right verb.

steps.name: Read backlog
steps.instruction: Auto-detect source from CLAUDE.md (Linear, GitHub) or accept user list. Parse items: title, description, labels, status, assignee.

steps.name: Categorize
steps.instruction: Each item: feature, bug, tech debt, or question. Extract acceptance criteria if present. Note dependency links.
checklist: Every item categorized with deps noted

steps.name: Enterprise cross-reference
steps.instruction: Cross-reference against endpoint registry: uncovered 'in' endpoints are implicit high-priority items. Check scope for conflicts. Check parity systems for uncovered entities.
checklist: Uncovered endpoints surfaced, scope conflicts flagged

steps.name: Prioritize
steps.instruction: Rank: blockers first, then dep order, severity, age. Apply routing-policy priority: incident > missed commitment > unblock > contribution > uncertainty reduction > switch cost. Preserve current work by default.
checklist: Items ranked per routing policy priority
Current work preserved unless justified switch

steps.name: Route to verb
steps.instruction: Present ranked list with verb: feature without spec -> /spec, with spec -> /breakdown, bug -> /diagnose, tech debt -> /tdd, question -> /grill-with-docs. Note likely impact facets for downstream. User picks, hand off.
checklist: Ranked list with verbs presented, user picked, handed off

tone: Brief. Dispatch desk, not project manager. Facts, route fast.
